Good to know

  • Members pay only ZMW 75 per person, per night, for utilities and housekeeping.
  • No hidden costs.
  • Children under 5 are free (immediate family).
  • Your membership extends to ShareVilles Chankumba and a possible third location at no extra cost.
  • Discounts for off-season, group and longer stays. Rates may rise each year with inflation.
  • Open to all after a simple interview. Limited numbers.

Built to last

Who stands behind it?

Kay Development Ltd, in business since 2006, valued at over USD 300,000 and legal guarantor of your investment.

Contract and constitution

Membership contracts are legally binding. The ShareVilles Constitution sets the framework for long-term commitments.

One member, one vote

The constitution allows referendums, so the community can evolve and stay strong.

Exit options

Sell or transfer at any time. Claim a full refund at any point if Kay Development Ltd falls short of its commitments (terms in the Membership Contract).
